svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"cord-mar-competition-team","name":"Region Cadet Competition winning team","size_in":{"w":0.77,"h":4.22},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,77,422],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1. Length 4.1 in = the Class B shirt shoulder seam (~4.1 in on garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male) and 0.3 in longer than the 3.8 in epaulet strap on the Class A coat (seam 5.04 in), so the cord stays inside the coat silhouette; 0.5 in across, the width the engine draws a shoulder cord at (it was 0.40 before the guidance's cord). The braid is the cord of the CAP honor guard uniform guidance figures, measured on the Class A figure (link pitch 28.0 px on a braid 38.65 px across: 0.36 in a link at 0.5 in across; the Class B figure agrees within 4 percent): see CordBraid.LOOK in base-art/cord-braid.js. Colours are the palette of assets/cords/cords.json.","provenance":"in-house vector: the braid is the cord of the CAP honor guard uniform guidance figures, its link, lobe, strip, outline and cap proportions measured on the figure (base-art/cord-braid.js); colours from the palette of assets/cords/cords.json (the regulation cords keep the colours they had). The green is the deep green of the three Vanguard kelly green cords (items 3738651, 3738650, 3740550238: hue 148 in the photographs), not the bright yellow-green of the web colour","colours":{"main":"#f1f2f4","groove":"#aeb4bc","edge":{"name":"white","main":"#f1f2f4","groove":"#aeb4bc"},"centre":{"name":"green","main":"#1f8951","groove":"#0d4a29"},"style":"edge-centre"},"anchors":{"top_center":[38.5,0],"bottom_center":[38.5,422],"center":[38.5,211],"left_edge":[0,211],"right_edge":[77,211],"shoulder_seam_attach":[51,6],"shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end":[51,6],"shoulder_seam_attach_arm_end":[51,416],"cord_mid":[26,211]},"dimensions":{"form":"braided shoulder cord (box braid, a chain of links of two barrelled lobes and a two-cell centre strip)","style":"edge-centre","length_in":4.1,"thickness_in":0.5,"sagitta_in":0.25,"link_pitch_in":0.3622,"outline_in":0.0285,"cap_length_in":0.1358,"orientation":"drawn vertically: top = neck end of the shoulder seam, bottom = sleeve (arm) end; the bow (0.25 in) falls toward the body, i.e. down the garment front when the cord lies on the shoulder","attach":"align cord_start (neck end) with the neck end of the wearer's LEFT shoulder seam and run it down the seam toward the shoulder point; rotate to the seam angle"},"garment_fit":{"note":"strap axis = line from the neck end to the arm end of the garment's left epaulet strap / shoulder strip (garment user units, 0.01 in; wearer's left shoulder is on the viewer's right). Place: centre the cord on the axis with shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end at the neck end, rotate so the neck->arm anchors follow the axis, shift the chord 0.125 in toward the neck side so the 0.25 in bow is centred on the strap; draw order garment, layers, cord, then the epaulet sleeve/strip over it","class_a_coat":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-a-coat","left_shoulder_seam_in":5.48,"strap_axis":[[1796.1,262.9],[2198.7,368.7]],"strap_len_in":4.16,"note":"strap from the garment-blues-class-a-cadet-officer-insignia shoulder-strip-left"},"class_a_coat_female":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-a-coat-female","strap_axis":[[1656.5,191],[2008.5,265]],"strap_len_in":3.6,"note":"strap from garment-blues-class-a-cadet-officer-insignia-female shoulder-strip-left"},"class_b_shirt":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male","left_shoulder_seam_in":4.1,"strap_axis":[[1368.2,193.3],[1775.4,345]],"strap_len_in":4.35,"note":"epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end"},"class_b_blouse_female":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female","strap_axis":[[1332.6,203.8],[1777.9,305.9]],"strap_len_in":4.57,"note":"epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end"}},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Class A (service dress) and Class B (blue service), cadets only","rule":"worn on the left shoulder, aligned along the shoulder seam, underneath the epaulet if present; one cord at a time; who may wear it and where is the wing or region supplement's rule (CAPR 39-1 9.4.1)"}],"regulation":"CAPR 39-1 9.4.1 and the wing or region supplement that names it","grade":"cord"}
